results.detail: Failure produced a handled marker; approval invalidation was never called.
When current fetch returns existing A, reconciliation still activates higher-ID B.
A failed download for new snapshot 2 returned successful snapshot-1 data without a failure row.
A made-up hash/size with no file path passes the same verifier used by pre-flight and confirmation.
An empty section with matching heading and an explicit denial both produce COVERED.
Verified evidence for proposal v1 still yields SATISFIED when v2 coverage is unknown.
The same provider/model/evidence counted twice and satisfied a critical requirement.
A prior incomplete extraction with unchanged inventory skipped both AI passes despite use_ai=True.
New extracted recipient/deadline did not replace prior inferred values; removed file remained required.
PDF and XLSX constraints intersect to empty, causing file_types=NOT_APPLICABLE even for .exe.
An open listing whose deadline passed 30 days ago is eligible_for_pursuit=True.
A pursuit at won is rendered in Approved to Bid because the old review remains approved_to_bid.
The actual outcome route discarded a won award value when the later hidden lost input was empty.
Removing all active registry versions does not disable use: disk-active prompt is returned.
A configured Anthropic primary provider still received skip_ai=True in approve-to-bid generation.
Source time 25:99 raises ValueError instead of producing an unknown validation result.
A reviewer changed a submitted bid's quote_price to 999 without a correction or invalidation workflow.
Cross-origin login POST sets an HttpOnly/Lax session cookie without CSRF rejection or Secure.
Actual built wheel contains no web assets; isolated create_app() fails with missing static directory.
With top 50 already rule-matched, candidate 51 exists but no semantic recommendation is returned.
SMTP login and digest delivery proceed when the server does not advertise STARTTLS.
Registry sync upsert activates safety-critical disk-active prompt without running its activation gate.
HTTP-200 non-JSON response escapes as JSONDecodeError; engine catches only DecisionProviderUnavailable.
Summary query has no active filter and old removed attachment text reached the provider prompt.
With no supplier/pursuit evidence, buyer's 30-day requirement became supplier lead time and feasibility=yes.
Coverage for opportunity 1 accepted version 99 of another proposal without loading/verifying its owner.
